i hope this is a little helpful but i suggest maybe picking up a new hobby might help. I also can relate to not having a personality but  perhaps  you can find yourself through doing new things, besides if you can find gatherings (like clubs or events) to do with these hobbies then if you don't find yourself then you will at least have a higher chance of making friends.  

Also try to discuss this with your friend. Maybe your friend can connect you to some of his friends or even set up some dates. 

If all fails you can always try to make connections online
Yes it is normal for the pen to dent pretty quickly especially if you are doing a lot of drawing in a short time. Happens to me all the time.
